channel.name: Still Hours
channel.positioning: Long-form ambient pieces for adults who want to sleep, focus, or study without interruptions. No talking heads, no ads mid-piece, no loops that give themselves away.
channel.audience: Adults 25-55, mostly listening on a phone or TV in the background, many with headphones.
channel.tone: Quiet, unhurried, sincere. Never mystical, never clinical.

format_spec._note: PILOT format: 5-10 minute pieces while audio/visual sources and the template are settled. The channel's launch format (long-form) is a later config change; do not publish pilots publicly.
hard_rules: No on-screen text except an optional title card in the first 10 seconds.
The last scene fades to black over its final 20 seconds.

audio_source: music_generator: one instrumental track for the full duration from a text-to-music model (ElevenLabs Eleven Music), generated from audio_brief.generation_prompt; no stems, no per-scene cues, so structure_by_scene is guidance the generator may only loosely follow
visual_source: generated_stills: one 16:9 still per scene from a text-to-image model, built from visual_style.generation_prompt_prefix + scene.visual_description; animated in the render template with push, drift, parallax, focus and exposure ramps and overlay particle layers only

recent_videos.theme: A cabin study during a mountain snowstorm, fire crackle, low cello
Slow star drift over a high desert, sparse synth pads
Rain on a greenhouse roof, piano and rain only

season_hint: early autumn in the northern hemisphere
